description: This PHP script handles mass editing of contact records in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves multiple record IDs, checks permissions, updates specified fields for each record, and redirects to the module's index page after processing.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity, used here to retrieve instances of record types such as Contacts.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an instance of a CRMEntity for a given module.
